title: (Senior) Customer Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Empower every employee. KI hat verändert, wie Büroangestellte arbeiten. Bei den 80 % der weltweiten Belegschaft , die nicht am Schreibtisch sitzen, ist sie bisher kaum angekommen. Flip AI ändert das. Flip AI ist das #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) , mit dem sich jeder Anwendungsfall für Frontline-Teams aufbauen, automatisieren und orchestrieren lässt, auf einem Fundament aus sicherer Identität, Kommunikation und starker UX. In der Praxis heißt das: eine App, über die Frontline-Mitarbeitende in Handel, Produktion und Logistik auf ihre Systeme zugreifen, ihre Prozesse abwickeln und KI nutzen. Mehr als 1.000 Marken vertrauen Flip AI, und über zwei Millionen Menschen weltweit nutzen die Plattform, bei Unternehmen wie Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA und Greif. Im August 2026 haben Notion Capital und HV Capital mit einer neuen Runde über 25 Mio. US-Dollar erneut investiert, insgesamt sind es damit mehr als 85 Mio. US-Dollar . Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Stellenbeschreibung Als Customer Engineer arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Produkt und der Umgebung unserer Kund:innen: ihrem Identity-Stack, ihren HR-Systemen, ihrem Security Review, ihrer KI-Roadmap. Du bringst einen Tenant von null auf Hunderttausende aktive Nutzende und entscheidest, wie die technische Seite gelöst wird. Manchmal, indem du die Integration designst und die IT auf Kundenseite in die Lage versetzt, sie selbst zu bauen, manchmal, indem du die erste Version selbst baust und sie anschließend übergibst. Dazu gehört der Teil, an dem unsere KI beim Kunden live geht: Agents in der App, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter, die bisher niemand gelöst hat. Das erwartet dich bei uns Technische Verantwortung von Anfang bis Ende: Du verantwortest die technische Seite unserer Enterprise-Onboardings, vom ersten Architekturgespräch bis zum stabilen Rollout in der Breite. Integrationen, die Flip AI tragfähig machen: Du designst und lieferst Identity und Authentifizierung (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), SCIM-Provisioning, REST-APIs und Anbindungen an HR- und operative Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG. Beraten und befähigen statt selbst abarbeiten: Du führst die IT auf Kundenseite, ihre Partner und unsere externen Entwicklungspartner zu einer Lösung, die du selbst unterschreiben würdest, und sorgst dafür, dass sie ohne dich betrieben werden kann. Bauen, wo es den Rollout löst: Wo Bauen der schnellste Weg ist, einen Ansatz zu belegen oder ein Rollout wieder in Bewegung zu bringen, baust du die erste Version und übergibst sie danach sauber, mit Dokumentation und Übergabegespräch, damit sie Bestand hat. KI dort, wo sie auf den Kunden trifft: Du gestaltest, wie Agents, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und Agent-to-Agent-Szenarien in echten Enterprise-Umgebungen ankommen, inklusive der Auth- und Datengrenzen, die dabei halten müssen. Technische Autorität im Account: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit Projektleitung, IT, Security, Fachbereichen und Betriebsräten ab, entscheidest die technischen Fragen und gibst die Lücken, die du dabei siehst, an unser Produkt- und Engineering-Team zurück. Rechne mit regelmäßigen Reisen zu Kund:innen, etwa 10 bis 30 Prozent deiner Zeit. Das bringst du mit Must-haves Rund 3 bis 5 Jahre (oder mehr) in der IT- oder Tech-Beratung, im Customer Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering oder in der SaaS-Implementierung, mit echter Enterprise-Erfahrung. Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integration und Identity: SSO und Authentifizierung (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID oder vergleichbar), REST-APIs und API-basierte Integrationen, die du in echten Enterprise-IT-Landschaften geliefert hast. Technische Verantwortung am Kunden in Enterprise-Projekten, in denen du die technischen Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit IT, Security und Fachbereichen getroffen und nicht nur koordiniert hast. Echte technische Tiefe, ohne in Vollzeit Produktcode zu schreiben: Du liest Code, prüfst ein Design, debuggst eine Integration und baust einen funktionierenden Prototypen. Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher und fließendes Englisch. Nice-to-haves Erfahrung mit SCIM-Provisioning und Anbindungen an HR- oder Workforce-Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG. Ein fundierter, aktueller Blick darauf, wohin sich agentische KI entwickelt: MCP, A2A, EMA und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter. Wir suchen jemanden, der das Feld eng verfolgt und eine eigene Meinung dazu hat, keine Jahre an Erfahrung, die es noch nicht geben kann. Vorerfahrung als Customer Engineer oder Forward Deployed Engineer in einem Produktunternehmen statt ausschließlich in der klassischen Beratung. Tools zur Workflow-Automatisierung (n8n oder ähnlich), Routine mit Logs, Metriken und Dashboards oder Erfahrung mit Mitbestimmung und Datenschutz im Enterprise-Umfeld. Das bieten wir dir Work-Mode: Wir sind remote-first und geben dir damit die Flexibilität, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir den Mehrwert der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit sehr. Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil – selbstverständlich immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Das genaue Verhältnis besprechen wir transparent während deines Bewerbungsprozesses. Work-Life-Balance: Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst und übernehmen deshalb die Kosten für deine E-Gym-Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und bieten Job-Rad Leasing an. Erfolge feiern: Dich erwarten hoch motivierte und engagierte Menschen in einer lockeren Arbeitsatmosphäre. Mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du gestaltest Flip AI aktiv mit. Ganz nebenbei bist du Enabler des rasanten Wachstumsprozesses eines jungen Tech-Unternehmens und wächst an deinen Zielen. Gute Laune garantiert. Happy to be a Flipster: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents und Culture Days, die uns als Flipster zusammenschweißen. Arbeiten im Ausland: Bei Flip AI kannst du auch im europäischen Ausland arbeiten, lass uns im Interview über Workation sprechen. Damit unsere Stellenanzeigen leichter lesbar sind, verwenden wir im Textverlauf die männliche Form der Anrede. title: (Senior) Customer Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Empower every employee. AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that. Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI. More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round , bringing our total funding to more than $85M . Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Job Description As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet. What you can expect Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale. Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you. Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick. AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them. Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time. What you bring to the table Must-haves Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure. Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments. Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them. Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype. German at C1 level or above and fluent English. Nice-to-haves Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet. Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only. Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection. What we offer you Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview. Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing. Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere. Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed. Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters. Working abroad: At Flip AI you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview. At Flip AI, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Job Description As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them. Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them. Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it. Your role You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact. This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day. What you will be doing, among others: Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape; Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely; Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability; Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform; Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies; Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices; Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example. The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better. Most important benefits Salary : Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position. Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures; You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code; You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically; You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in; You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process; You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript; You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Candidates in Pacific time are also welcome, with flexibility to support leaders and teams across global time zones.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Own complex, high-volume calendars across multiple time zones for both VPs, adapting to changes and advising on prioritization, delegation, and time management.</li> <li>Prepare recurring leadership meetings and all-hands, coordinate agendas and presentation materials, confirm attendance, and participate in team calls to identify and follow through on action items.</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, ground transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation; anticipate disruptions and arrange alternatives when plans change.</li> <li>Plan and execute off-sites, team-building activities, and company kickoffs, coordinating with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.</li> <li>Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics.</li> <li>Prepare accurate monthly expense reports for both leaders, including receipt collection and reconciliation.</li> <li>Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to streamline research, drafting, and recurring administrative work, checking outputs for accuracy, context, and usefulness rather than relying on automated summaries alone.</li> <li>Provide temporary coverage for other executive support partners and lead special projects and ad hoc requests across the CRO organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting multiple senior leaders or VP-level executives simultaneously in a technology company, with the ability to learn their working styles and business priorities.</li> <li>Bias for action and ownership<strong>:</strong> recognize what needs to happen, act independently within agreed priorities, and communicate progress and completion without repeated prompting.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, exercising judgment about competing requests, and checking scheduling details and attendees.</li> <li>Skill in coordinating domestic and international travel and team events, anticipating dependencies, responding to disruptions, and confirming arrangements rather than stopping at an inquiry.</li> <li>Proficiency with tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Navan, Claude and GitLab, alongside experience with expense reporting, recruiting coordination, and onboarding logistics.</li> <li>Clear, approachable communication across functions and levels, sound judgment with confidential information, and the ability to build trusted working relationships.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI tools to improve administrative work, with the judgment to validate outputs, capture context, and retain responsibility for the result.</li> <li>An organized, reliable approach to balancing priorities across two leaders and their teams. title: Senior Full Stack Developer (f/m/d) | DE + EN + FR/ES/IT
description: Über HappyOps HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für mittelständische Industrieunternehmen in Europa. Unsere Kunden kommen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen, darunter der Glas, Metall, Kunststoff und Maschinenbauindustrie. Gemeinsam mit ihnen digitalisieren wir Produktionsprozesse und entwickeln individuelle Softwarelösungen, die täglich in realen Fabriken eingesetzt werden. Wir sind ein profitables, eigenfinanziertes Softwareunternehmen mit einem vollständig remote arbeitenden Engineering Team. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, direkter Kommunikation und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Über die Rolle Wir suchen eine n erfahrene n Senior Full Stack Softwareentwickler*in (f/m/d) mit verhandlungssicheren Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen sowie sehr guten Kenntnissen (mindestens C1) in mindestens einer weiteren Sprache: Französisch, Spanisch oder Italienisch. In dieser Rolle entwickelst du nicht nur Software, sondern arbeitest eng mit unseren internationalen Kunden zusammen, verstehst ihre Prozesse und setzt gemeinsam mit unserem Team moderne Lösungen für die produzierende Industrie um. Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zum produktiven Einsatz und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit pragmatischer Problemlösung. Aufgaben Entwicklung, Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb individueller Softwarelösungen für Kunden aus der produzierenden Industrie. Du verantwortest, was du entwickelst. You build it, you run it. Umsetzung komplexer Businesslogik mit modernen Technologien und Softwarearchitekturen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Anwendungen. Entwicklung intuitiver Web UIs, die komplexe Fertigungsprozesse einfach und effizient abbilden. Entwicklung, Betrieb und Wartung skalierbarer Cloud und On Premise Anwendungen inklusive Monitoring, Logging und Fehleranalyse. Entwicklung und Integration von Schnittstellen zu ERP Systemen, Manufacturing Software, Maschinensteuerungen, Sensoren und weiterer OT Infrastruktur. Analyse technischer Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Projektmanagern und Kunden sowie Übersetzung dieser Anforderungen in robuste Softwarelösungen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden während des gesamten Projektverlaufs, von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Implementierung bis zum produktiven Einsatz. Kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Plattform, Entwicklungsprozesse und technischen Standards sowie aktive Mitgestaltung unserer Produkt und Technologie Roadmap. Qualifikation Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Full Stack Softwareentwickler*in in einem professionellen Entwicklungsumfeld. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express.js, modernen Webtechnologien sowie im Schreiben automatisierter Tests. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie mindestens C1-Kenntnisse in einer weiteren Sprache (Französisch, Spanisch oder Italienisch). Du kannst technische Anforderungen eigenständig mit internationalen Kunden besprechen und Workshops in diesen Sprachen durchführen. Erfahrung mit Cloud Architekturen, APIs und modernen Softwareentwicklungsprozessen. Kenntnisse im Bereich Industrial IoT, Maschinenkommunikation oder Industrieprotokolle sind ein Plus. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Lösungen und bringst Projekte zuverlässig zum Abschluss. Du denkst pragmatisch, lernst schnell und hast Freude daran, komplexe technische Herausforderungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und dem Team zu lösen. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen fundiert begründen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und bist gleichzeitig offen für neue Perspektiven und konstruktives Feedback. Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und behältst auch in dynamischen Projekten den Überblick. Du hast Freude an der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden sowie mit unserem Gründungsteam und möchtest die technische Zukunft von HappyOps aktiv mitgestalten. Benefits Entwickle Software mit echtem Einfluss. Deine Lösungen werden täglich in Fabriken eingesetzt und helfen Unternehmen, produktiver, ressourcenschonender und wettbewerbsfähiger zu werden. Arbeite an anspruchsvollen technischen Herausforderungen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Software, Maschinen, Daten und industriellen Prozessen. Gestalte die technische und organisatorische Weiterentwicklung von HappyOps aktiv mit und bringe deine Ideen direkt ein. Arbeite in einem kleinen, erfahrenen Engineering Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und direktem Austausch mit den Gründern. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, vollständig remote und eine Kultur, die Ergebnisse höher bewertet als Anwesenheit. Freie Wahl deiner Entwicklungsumgebung und deines IT Equipments, damit du mit den Werkzeugen arbeiten kannst, die für dich am besten funktionieren. Ein attraktives Gehalt sowie die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich in einem wachsenden Softwareunternehmen weiterzuentwickeln. Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt, abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation, zwischen 70.000 € und 100.000 € brutto pro Jahr . Bei HappyOps zählen für uns Kompetenz, Motivation und Teamfit. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, sexueller Identität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion oder einer Behinderung. Klingt die Rolle spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich zu bewerben. Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf sowie deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung. Kennst du jemanden, der perfekt zu uns passen könnte? Für jede erfolgreiche Empfehlung, die zu einer Einstellung führt, zahlen wir eine Empfehlungsprämie von 1.500 € . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Your work directly supports national security missions, including customers operating within FedRAMP-authorized, air-gapped, and classified or semi-classified environments where traditional troubleshooting approaches are not always possible.</p> <p>In this role, you will engage deeply with GitLab through the command line; analyzing logs, system behavior, and application performance with strong Linux fundamentals and an understanding of how GitLab’s components interact end-to-end. You may partner with Product and Engineering to reproduce and document edge-case defects using sanitized or redacted data, or contribute directly to the product by opening merge requests that resolve customer-impacting issues. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help strengthen GitLab by improving documentation, support workflows, and institutional knowledge, ensuring that lessons learned in highly regulated environments benefit the broader platform; all while working in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment built on trust, autonomy, and shared ownership.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/strace-parser"><u><span class="textUnderline">A tool to quickly analyze strace output</span></u></a></li> <li value="2"><a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos"><u><span class="textUnderline">A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting</span></u></a></li> <li value="3"><a class="textLink" href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/chatops/"><u><span class="textUnderline">A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</span></u></a></li> </ul> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></h2> <ul> <li value="1">Collaborate closely with public sector customers, including U.S. government agencies, the Department of War, and Intelligence Community organizations, to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues in GitLab deployments operating under strict security, compliance, and operational constraints.</li> <li value="2">Perform deep, hands-on technical investigations using Linux command-line tooling and GitLab internals to analyze logs, system performance, and application behavior, often with limited telemetry or incomplete datasets. You will trace issues across infrastructure, application, and code paths to identify root causes, recommend mitigations, and drive durable fixes; frequently partnering with GitLab Product, Development, and Infrastructure teams to ensure outcomes that meet both mission and platform reliability requirements.</li> <li value="3">Create and update clear, reusable documentation and support content based on real customer interactions to improve self-service and reduce repeated issues.</li> <li value="4">Participate in regular<a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w"> <u><span <u><span class="textUnderline">stable counterpart</span></u></a> to cross-functional teams to share knowledge and improve support processes.</li> <li value="5">Contribute to building and refining internal support tools and workflows, including automation and troubleshooting utilities, to make diagnosing and resolving issues more efficient.</li> <li value="6">Participate in weekday and weekend on-call rotations, providing timely emergency support for self-managed customers operating in restricted and compliance-focused environments.</li> <li value="7">Support the growth of the team by reviewing applications and assessments, and participating in interviews and hiring decision discussions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></h2> <ul> <li value="1">Due to government security requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to be eligible for this position</li> <li value="2">Experience managing customer-facing cases across the full support lifecycle, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution</li> <li value="3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge, with the ability to troubleshoot performance and configuration issues in complex environments</li> <li value="4">Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered developer tooling and gateway architectures (for example GitLab Duo, AI gateway configurations, or similar model-serving/proxy layers), including how they're deployed and troubleshot in self-managed or air-gapped environments</li> <li value="5">Ability to use scripting languages (preferably Ruby or Bash) and work within model-view-controller frameworks (preferably Ruby on Rails) to investigate and resolve issues</li> <li value="6">Practical experience with Git and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows</li> <li value="7">Skill value="10">Understanding of common information security and compliance concepts and controls (for example DISA STIG and SELinux), and eligibility to work on United States federal customer environments as required for this role</li> </ul> <h2><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></h2> <p>At GitLab Federal, LLC, the U.S. Government Support Engineering team partners with description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. About the Role We're looking for a Sr. Director of Machine Learning to lead the teams building the AI services at the core of the Hims & Hers experience. This leader owns the applied side of our AI portfolio: the LLM-powered services that handle clinical intake, provider support, personalization, and operational workflows, as well as the in-house deep learning models that drive recommendations and predictions where accuracy and clinical soundness matter most. This is a builder's leadership role. You'll set the technical direction for how we turn foundation models and custom models into dependable production services, grow a team of ML modelers and ML production engineers, and partner with our ML platform and evaluation organization to make sure what we ship is measurable, safe, and continuously improving. You will: Lead and grow ML engineers, applied scientists, and ML production engineers building AI services end to end — from problem framing through production operation. Own the strategy for how we build on top of frontier LLMs: prompt and context design, retrieval, tool and function calling, agentic workflows, structured output reliability, fallback and degradation behavior, latency and cost management. Drive the design of the harnesses and glue around LLM calls — orchestration, validation, guardrails, deterministic scaffolding — so probabilistic components produce dependable, auditable outputs inside product and clinical workflows. Direct development of in-house deep learning and classical ML models where a custom model outperforms a general-purpose one, including clinical and recommendation use cases such as medication and treatment-plan recommendations surfaced to providers. Set the bar for how AI services are productionized: SLOs for accuracy, latency and cost, graceful failure, rollout strategy, and clear ownership of production behavior. Make build-versus-fine-tune-versus-prompt decisions deliberately, and revisit them as model capabilities and pricing shift. Partner with Clinical and Medical Affairs to ensure clinically-facing models are developed with appropriate oversight, validation, and human-in-the-loop design; ensure providers stay in control of clinical decisions. Partner closely with the ML infrastructure and evaluation team members to define evaluation criteria, feedback loops, and annotation needs for every service your team ships — and to hold your team accountable to the resulting metrics. Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Security, Legal, and Compliance to translate ambiguous business and clinical problems into scoped, high-leverage ML work. Establish engineering and scientific standards across the team: experiment design, model documentation, reproducibility, code quality, and responsible AI practices. Build the team's hiring, leveling, and mentorship practices; develop senior individual contributors and managers. Act as a senior technical voice in the AI organization, shaping multi-year roadmap and investment decisions and representing AI strategy to executive leadership. You have: 14+ years of experience in machine learning and software engineering, including 8+ years leading ML teams and experience managing managers or senior tech leads. A track record of shipping ML-powered products to production at scale — not just prototypes or research — and owning them operationally over time. Depth in understanding modern LLM application development: RAG, prompt engineering, fine-tuning and adaptation, evaluation, agent and tool-calling architectures, and the practical limits of each. Real experience training and deploying deep learning models (recommendation, ranking, classification, or sequence models) where model quality directly affects user or business outcomes. Strong software architecture judgment — you can reason about service boundaries, data flow, failure modes, and cost as fluently as you can about model architecture. Experience balancing model quality against latency, cost, and operational complexity, and making those tradeoffs legible to non-technical partners. Comfort operating with ambiguity: taking a vague, high-value problem and turning it into a shipped system with measurable impact. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence peers, executives, and clinical stakeholders. Bonus: experience in healthcare, digital health, or another regulated domain or with safety-critical ML systems. Bonus: experience with clinical decision support, clinical NLP, or ML systems where a human expert is the end user. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a product engineering team at ClickUp. This is an open team placement role: you'll join a product team based on your strengths and our business priorities, rather than being hired into a single predefined product area. Across teams, the mandate is the same: build a strong team, ship useful product improvements, and take ownership of the quality and reliability of what you deliver. Engineering Managers at ClickUp are hands-on. You'll lead from the front: reading and reviewing code daily, debugging production issues alongside your team, prototyping when it unblocks a decision, and shipping code yourself when the team needs it. Your technical credibility is how you earn trust, set the bar, and make good calls quickly. You'll also own people management, delivery, and team execution. Working closely with product, design, and technical leads, you'll turn customer problems into clear priorities and achievable milestones. You'll develop engineers, make trade-offs explicit, and keep work moving without letting quality or maintainability become someone else's problem. You'll also run an AI-native team . We structure work so AI agents can read it, route it, roll it up, and report on it. Progress and team health should be visible from real signals, with reporting available self-serve rather than dependent on status meetings. We want a manager who has used AI to remove busywork and improve how a team builds, and who can help engineers use it responsibly across planning, implementation, testing, and operations. Responsibilities Lead and develop a product engineering team. Own hiring, onboarding, mentorship, performance, and career growth, and build a team where expectations are clear and feedback is direct. Own delivery from planning through release and follow-through. Break work into clear milestones, manage dependencies, surface risks early, and make realistic commitments. Set priorities with product, design, and engineering leadership. Connect engineering work to customer needs and business outcomes, and make deliberate trade-offs between new features, reliability, and technical debt. Lead from the front technically. Stay close to the codebase: review PRs, dig into production issues, write code and prototypes when it unblocks the team, and know your systems well enough to spot risk before it ships. Drive architecture and implementation decisions with your technical leads and senior engineers. Bring real depth to design discussions, challenge assumptions with specifics, and make the call when the team is stuck. Run an AI-native team. Use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve planning, development, testing, triage, and reporting, while maintaining clear ownership and human review where it matters. Uphold a high engineering bar across design and code review, automated testing, performance, security, and maintainability. Build quality into delivery rather than treating it as a final checkpoint. Own the operational health of your team's product area. Establish appropriate monitoring, safe rollout practices, incident response, and on-call ownership, and turn production issues into lasting improvements. Collaborate across product teams and shared platform teams to resolve dependencies and deliver coherent customer experiences. Keep priorities, progress, risks, and decisions visible. Use evidence to improve team execution and product outcomes, rather than optimizing for activity counts. Requirements 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building production software, including substantial time as a hands-on senior engineer, with 2+ years managing an engineering team. You still code. You're comfortable working in a modern production codebase (TypeScript, Node.js, React, or similar), reviewing PRs with substance, and debugging across the stack. A track record of delivering customer-facing SaaS products or services, with ownership extending beyond launch to reliability, maintenance, and customer outcomes. Experience hiring, coaching, and developing engineers, including giving direct feedback, managing performance, and supporting career growth. Deep technical judgment. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs from first-hand experience, and hold a high engineering bar because you know what good looks like in the code. Experience partnering closely with product and design to define priorities, scope work, and deliver against clear milestones. A demonstrated ability to use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering work and reduce manual coordination, with attention to correctness, security, and review. Comfort working through ambiguity, learning unfamiliar product areas, and making decisions with incomplete information. Clear communication and effective cross-functional collaboration. You make ownership, trade-offs, risks, and next steps easy to understand. Daily fluency with AI tools in your own workflow. Preferred Qualifications Recent, meaningful code contributions as a manager: features, fixes, tooling, or prototypes you shipped yourself. Experience managing engineers across frontend and backend, or leading delivery across multiple technical disciplines. Experience building and operating software at scale, including performance, reliability, safe migrations, and incident management. Experience in a fast-moving product organization, balancing customer-facing delivery with platform improvements and technical debt. Experience introducing AI-native or agent-driven workflows to an engineering team, with measurable improvements in quality or execution. Experience building collaboration, productivity, or workflow software, or products used by both individual users and enterprise customers. Experience leading distributed teams across time zones. description: About Our Company: Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients. About the Position: The Sr. Engineer – Commissioning is responsible for directing and/or supporting planning, coordinating, and executing all commissioning activities associated with mission-critical data center projects. This role ensures that mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), controls, and security are designed, installed, tested, and operated in accordance with project requirements and industry best practices. The Sr. Engineer - Commissioning supports the Sr. Director of Commissioning and works closely with design teams, general contractors, trade partners, equipment vendors, commissioning agents, and operations personnel to deliver fully functional facilities ready for turnover. The ideal candidate has direct commissioning experience in mission-critical environments, with a strong understanding of electrical distribution systems, backup power generation, UPS systems, multiple cooling systems, BMS/EPMS controls, and liquid cooled systems. This individual must be comfortable working in a fast-paced construction environment while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, schedule, details, and operational readiness. What you do daily: Develop, with the Sr. Director of Commissioning, commissioning standards for the company to apply to all future projects. Support in the development in commissioning plans on a per project basis. Support and/or lead commissioning activities for projects from pre-design through turnover and occupancy, including L1 activities as required, and L2 through L5. Coordinate commissioning schedules with project managers, contractors, vendors, and commissioning agents to support overall project milestones. Assist in managing the OFCI vendor equipment delivery schedules to align with construction and commissioning requirements. Review and approve commissioning scripts developed by the commissioning agent for projects Review design documents, equipment submittals, and sequences of operation to ensure systems can be tested and commissioned effectively. Track commissioning progress and maintain commissioning logs, issue lists, deficiency reports, and turnover documentation. Attend factory witness testing (FWT) where required Facilitate site acceptance testing (SAT) for all equipment. Verify installation, pre-energization and startup of electrical, mechanical, controls, security and life-safety systems in accordance with project requirements. Participate in commissioning meetings and provide regular status updates to project leadership and stakeholders. Coordinate functional performance testing of UPS systems, generators, switchgear, chillers, fan walls, split systems, CRAHs/CRACs, BMS, EPMS, and other critical systems. title: Community Strategy Manager - Hawaii
description: Job Title: Community Strategy Manager - Hawaii Department: Customer Success About the Role : The Community Strategy Manager will provide the operational and analytical backbone that allows the Community Strategy Leadership to focus on designing and executing on a cross-functional vision for the connection between our customers and their community partners. This role ensures that our community strategy is consistently executed across Customer Success and Sales by standardizing processes, managing escalation tracking in Salesforce, and coordinating with RevOps and Analytics to capture the right data. By supporting and tracking customer escalations, the Community Strategy Manager demonstrates the measurable effectiveness of escalation campaigns and adoption efforts. This role sits at the intersection of process design, analytics, and consultative enablement. You’ll ensure internal teams have the tools, insights, and frameworks needed to engage partners, resolve escalations, and drive adoption at scale. By connecting community strategy with data and performance measurement, you’ll help demonstrate the effectiveness of our engagement efforts both internally and with customers. Collaborate with Sales and Implementation teams to align on customer onboarding and embed community processes early. Retention & Engagement Drive retention across assigned customer accounts. Actively partner with community-based organizations to strengthen relationships and address shared goals. Collaborate closely with Marketing and Revenue Operations teams to align strategies and ensure community-focused objectives are met. Foster meaningful connections that enhance customer and community outcomes. Operational Process Maintain SOPs, playbooks, and triage processes for consistent handling of community escalations. Facilitate weekly escalation review meetings and track follow-up actions across teams. Analytics & Insights Track, and report escalation campaign metrics in Salesforce. Monitor adoption, network health, and partner engagement data, for key customers and geographies, as needed Manage customer surveys following escalations to measure satisfaction and demonstrate effectiveness of resolution efforts. Be innovative & think outside the box when it comes to developing new models that drive user adoption Communication and Events Work with Marketing on Community-facing materials Support Community-focused Marketing events. Demonstrated success building relationships across multiple stakeholder groups, including customers, community partners, government agencies, or cross-functional internal teams. Experience managing complex projects or programs that require coordination across multiple organizations, competing priorities, and changing timelines. Strong analytical and operational skills with experience using data to measure outcomes, identify opportunities, and improve processes. Experience documenting processes, developing playbooks or standard operating procedures, or driving operational consistency across teams. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where processes, priorities, and customer needs continue to develop. Unite Us quickly expanded to serving all people who need connections to care across our country. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities. We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. If you want to do well and do good, join Unite Us. title: Senior Technical Account Manager - Strategic Services
description: At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. We're hiring a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) who has already done this job at a SaaS company: someone who has led implementations, owned enterprise accounts and knows what it takes to drive adoption in complex organizations. You'll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to our customers, combining strong relationship management with deep knowledge of ClickUp's platform. This role sits where customer success, solution strategy and technical enablement meet, and it drives long-term growth, adoption and measurable business outcomes. TAMs own the full post-sales customer lifecycle. That starts with implementation and onboarding and continues through ongoing managed services, strategic expansion and renewal outcomes across your book of business. This role requires an AI-native professional who doesn't just use AI tools but designs, builds and scales AI-powered workflows and agents, and brings that hands-on expertise to customers. TAMs lead with a customer-first mindset. You'll build success plans, guide onboarding and adoption and make sure stakeholders keep seeing value throughout their lifecycle. You'll support technical initiatives like process optimization, workflow design and AI enablement, and you'll also own the overall health, engagement and strategic direction of your accounts. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Product and Support so each customer's success story is long-term, scalable and impactful. Technical Account Managers (TAMs) deliver measurable value and meaningful business outcomes across their customer portfolio by focusing on: Customer Enablement & Onboarding: Guiding new teams through implementation, onboarding and training for a smooth start and a strong foundation. Account Health & Engagement: Proactively managing user adoption, stakeholder alignment and account health to support retention and growth. Process Optimization & Solution Design: Working with customers to identify critical business processes, map them to scalable solutions and keep improving efficiency through ongoing refinement and performance insights. Innovation Adoption & Workflow Automation: Helping customers use emerging features and technologies, including AI and automation, to boost productivity, streamline operations and deliver real-world impact. Core Responsibilities TAMs are the strategic and technical owner of the customer relationship. They make sure every customer gets measurable results from ClickUp's product and AI feature set. New Customer Onboarding Lead end-to-end onboarding and implementation of ClickUp, from discovery and solution design through training and go-live support. Translate functional and technical requirements into scalable ClickUp solutions, including workflows, templates, hierarchies and automations. Guide customers through foundational setup, integrations and enablement while promoting best practices, system governance and change management. Account Health Management Monitor seat utilization, adoption trends and Champion/Stakeholder engagement. Build and run adoption plans and account reviews to maintain or improve health. Spot risks early and build recovery plans with the account team. Deliver ongoing change management and enablement so customers keep maturing on the platform. Workflow Mapping (IER Framework) Run Intake → Execution → Reporting (IER) cycles for key workflows. Lead discovery sessions that map current-state and future-state processes. Recommend optimizations and create workflow templates that scale across teams. AI Enablement & Agent Deployment Drive adoption of ClickUp AI and build custom workflow Agents tied to customer use cases. Partner with customers to define and deliver new AI automations aligned to their business KPIs. Provide technical training and consultation on AI and automation best practices, including prompt design, agent architecture and scaling use cases across teams. Track and report AI usage and credit consumption against plan. Customer Success & Expansion Serve as the technical partner to assigned accounts and connect adoption to business value. Drive value across the full post-implementation lifecycle by providing continued and managed services as customers expand their use of ClickUp. Generate qualified leads through data-driven insights and AI usage analysis. Drive cross-functional alignment to position renewals, expansions and AI upsells. Cross-Functional Collaboration Act as the voice of the customer by turning business objectives and pain points into actionable insights for Product, Engineering and Support. Partner with account teams to keep delivery and success aligned. Qualifications Required 5+ years in a customer-facing SaaS role (Technical Account Manager, Customer Success Manager, Implementation Manager, Solutions Consultant, Professional Services Consultant or similar) 2+ years of hands-on experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com , Smartsheet, Wrike, Jira or a comparable work management/project management platform Direct experience leading enterprise SaaS implementations or onboarding programs end-to-end, and/or a proven track record managing a book of business ($2M+ ARR) with measurable retention and expansion outcomes Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI-powered workflows, agents or automations in a business context Strong project and program management skills, including complex, multi-stakeholder engagements Preferred Background in professional services, implementation management or consulting at a SaaS company Hands-on experience with agentic tools and frameworks such as Claude, n8n, Make, Zapier or LangChain Technical aptitude with integrations, APIs, automation logic and data modeling Experience positioning or selling services alongside renewals and expansions Core Skills & Competencies Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of work management platform capabilities, automation logic, integrations and AI Agent functionality. Able to turn business needs into technical solutions. AI-Native: Demonstrated experience designing and scaling AI-powered workflows, agents and automations, not just using AI tools. Skilled at identifying and scoping AI use cases and consumption plans. Consultative Discovery: Excellent at workflow analysis, process design and finding friction points. Uses structured discovery to map customer needs into scalable solutions. Project & Program Management: Manages complex customer programs with multiple stakeholders, deadlines and outcomes. Skilled at running structured account plans. Data & Reporting: Comfortable using dashboards and metrics to communicate health, adoption and ROI. Reads usage data to drive recommendations. Customer Engagement: Executive presence and strong communication skills. Builds trust with both executive (ATL) and day-to-day (BTL) stakeholders through credibility and clarity. Account Ownership: Fully accountable for an assigned book of business. Proactive, organized and driven to hit measurable outcomes. Collaboration & Influence: Works cross-functionally with the account team, Product and Sales to align on outcomes. Influences without authority through insight and results. What Sets You Apart You've worked at, implemented or sold against project management or work management platforms. You've run enterprise implementations and know change management firsthand. You think in workflows and systems, not just relationships. You've built something with AI that a team actually runs on, and you can walk us through how it works. You've carried a renewal or expansion number and know how to tie technical value to commercial outcomes. #LI-SM1 #LI-remote Equal Opportunity Employer ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. title: Senior Account Executive
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analyses, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams. Document and maintain accurate buying criteria, buying processes, next steps, and owners to ensure a reliable, evidence-based pipeline. Contribute to improving our sales handbook and processes by documenting best practices and opportunities for refinement. Provide account leadership and direction across pre- and post-sales, partnering closely with technical teams and customer success. Represent the voice of the customer by contributing product feedback and ideas to our public issue tracker. What you’ll bring Proven success in software sales, ideally in a Enterprise market context, managing a varied book of business. Ability to guide customers through the full buying journey, including defining buying criteria, mapping buying processes, and driving clear next steps. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business development, marketing, technical teams, and sales management. Experience documenting and maintaining accurate pipeline data and account plans based on evidence rather than assumptions. Skill in conducting and contributing to win/loss and root cause analyses, and sharing insights to improve team performance and processes. Proficiency in negotiation, presenting to customer stakeholders, and leading commercial discussions to close opportunities. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment. Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate. Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices. Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff. Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations. Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans. Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures. Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime. Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow. Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes. Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings. Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations. Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies. Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required. What you'll bring Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment. UK remote based role. Up to 50% travel at times. Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services. Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans. Progressive DevOps platform experience, including designing and implementing reliable, scalable systems with clear performance and security trade-offs. Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Ability to write clean, maintainable automation/integration code (e.g., Terraform modules, Ansible roles, scripts) and validate changes with appropriate testing and code review. Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling. Working knowledge of data consistency and integrity concepts (e.g., ACID properties) and how they impact migration design and performance trade-offs. Strong problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision. Comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment, using documented decisions (e.g., issues, proposals, and runbooks) to keep work unblocked across time zones while collaborating effectively across GitLab team members, partners, and customer stakeholders. Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or other advanced technical degree, or equivalent experience. #LI-CM1 About the team The Professional Services Technical Architect is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization. About the role We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle. Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work. The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on. This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security. What you'll do Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon. Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow. Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation. Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com. Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each. Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product. Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration. Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across: Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees. Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows. Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do. Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review. Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member. What you'll bring 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership. Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it. Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load. A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition. Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf. Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous. Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans. Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. title: Senior Solutions Architect | Germany | Remote
description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . Effective in understanding business needs and distilling the information into business and technical requirements. Stay current on Grafana Labs, observability, and related technologies. If you enjoy working with customers to help them succeed and thrive on working with leading-edge technologies, this is the role for you. Best practices for both using and deploying an o11y stack (visualization, alerting, metrics, logs, traces) - preferably with Grafana products (Grafana, Prometheus/Cortex/Enterprise Metrics, Loki/Enterprise Logs, Jaeger/Tempo). A proven track record of successful delivery of customer projects, preferably enterprise o11y implementations for large customers Excellent communication skills to communicate with customers, partners, and internal members. Kubernetes (kubectl, Helm, Tanka preferred). Experience with Cloud Platforms - AWS, GCP, Azure Bonus Points For: Self-starter, adept at picking up new skills and technologies, and eager to break new ground. Vision to help us take our company to the next level. Compensation & Rewards: In Germany , the base compensation range for this role is 109,700 EUR - 131,600 EUR. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
description: About Ping Identity : At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. Tel Aviv - Hybrid - Tel Aviv, Israel We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. This role requires a multidisciplinary approach, combining expertise in data engineering, software development, MLOps, and ML automation. You will develop scalable ML platforms, create tools and utilities to streamline workflows, and drive the adaptation that takes models from research to production without friction. Meet Our Team: We are an experienced team of engineers who are hard working and easy to get along with. We have each other’s backs and are constantly sharing knowledge and pitching in whatever is needed to make sure our team and product are successful. We thrive on shared goals and shared success.
