Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values . Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal. Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales. About the Role Maze customers need to reach the right participants and trust the quality of the people taking part in their studies. Recruitment is a critical part of research. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the recruitment and panel experience at Maze. You’ll help shape how customers recruit and manage participants across unmoderated, moderated, AI-moderated and future research experiences. This is a highly cross-functional product area that sits at the intersection of product, operations and our panel partner ecosystem. You’ll work in a trio with Engineering and Design while partnering closely with our Panel Operations team, GTM, Customer Success, Research Partners and other product teams. You’ll own the customer and participant experiences as well as the systems behind them, helping Maze deliver a recruitment experience that is high-quality, reliable and able to scale with increasingly complex customer needs. You’ll work on: Own and evolve the roadmap for recruitment and participant management across Maze. Improve participant quality by building stronger feedback loops, quality signals, filtering and experiences that reduce confusion for participants. Make it easier for customers to recruit the audiences they need across different study types, including more complex enterprise use cases. Use data and customer insights to understand panel performance and identify gaps in participant supply, quality and fulfillment. Partner with Panel Operations to continuously improve the tools, workflows and handoffs used to fulfill recruitment requests. Help evaluate and onboard new panel partners and identify where deeper integrations can improve quality, coverage or efficiency. Develop smarter ways to route studies to the right participant supply based on customer and study needs. Stay close to the operational side of recruitment so product decisions are grounded in how participant fulfillment actually happens. Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Research Partners to understand customer needs, recruitment feasibility and opportunities to improve the recruitment experience. Define and measure success across participant quality, fulfillment and the overall recruitment experience. You should apply if: You have experience as a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager owning meaningful product areas from discovery through execution. You’re highly autonomous and comfortable taking a problem, creating structure around it and driving it forward without waiting for perfect direction. You’re a clear, structured communicator who can bring others along in how you think about a problem, recommendation or decision. You’re comfortable working on products that span software, operations and external partners rather than living entirely within a single product surface. You’re comfortable getting close to operational workflows and using what you learn to make better product decisions. You have strong product judgment and can make thoughtful tradeoffs when there isn’t a perfect answer. You’re experienced partnering closely with Engineering and Design to take products from discovery through delivery and iteration. You think in systems and look for scalable product solutions rather than one-off workarounds. You’re comfortable balancing customer experience, business needs, operational realities and technical constraints. You thrive in an environment where you can move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information and continuously learn from customers and internal teams. Bonus points if you have: Strong data fluency and experience using data to understand problems, prioritize opportunities and measure product outcomes. Experience building products with a meaningful operational component. Marketplace or supply-and-demand product experience. Experience in operations, business development or other roles that required you to work across product and business problems. Experience managing stakeholders across multiple teams or functions. Experience working with external partners, vendors or integrations that are critical to the customer experience. Experience with user research or research participant recruitment. Inclusivity and Pay At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations. Why Maze is unique Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze. Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge. Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions Benefits Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid Flexible time off Meaningful equity Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever! $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year SWAG, we have some really cool swag Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here . Outreach Notice We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application , as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

title: Head of Tax Information Reporting
description: Who We Are At OKX , we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. About the Opportunity OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions. Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out. You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads. Location: remote available, with a strong preference for the US or EU. Some travel to OKX offices. What You'll Be Doing Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries. Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline. Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release. Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision. Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers. Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product. Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team. Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee. Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads. Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records. What We Look For In You 7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team. Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required. Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output. Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting. Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus. Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle. Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee. Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines. Nice to Haves Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting. Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale. Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments. Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks. Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit. A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting. Perks & Benefits Competitive total compensation package L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants More that we love to tell you along the process! OKX Statement: OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notice: All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website. Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice .

title: Project Development Manager- Data Centers, EMEA
description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The Infrastructure Acquisition Group The Infrastructure Acquisition Group secures the land, power, and data center capacity that enables the Nebius AI Cloud. We identify where Nebius should grow next, structure the commercial agreements that make that growth possible, and partner across engineering, energy, finance, legal, and development to bring new AI infrastructure online. We're a small, founding team building this function from the ground up across the Americas, leading the acquisition of colocation, build-to-suit, powered land, and other strategic infrastructure opportunities as one of the world's fastest-growing AI cloud platforms scales. Examples of Problems We're Solving Transform acquisitions into data center-ready projects. A signed agreement is only the beginning. You'll lead development planning, utility coordination, permitting, consultant management, and infrastructure planning to prepare projects for successful delivery. Keep development ahead of construction. Coordinate engineering, utilities, municipalities, and development partners so projects remain ready for execution while commercial negotiations conclude and infrastructure requirements evolve. Build a repeatable development program. Help establish the standards, development governance, readiness gates, and project controls that will support AI infrastructure development across the Americas. About the Role As a Development Manager, you'll lead the development of AI infrastructure projects across the Americas from executed agreement through construction readiness. Working within the Infrastructure Acquisition Group, you'll partner with Site Selection, Technical Due Diligence, Engineering, Energy, Finance, Legal, and Delivery to transform acquisitions into fully defined, development-ready projects. This is a build-phase role on a build-phase team. Many of the development standards, governance processes, readiness gates, and project controls you'll use are still being written—in some cases, you'll help write them. We're looking for someone who can independently lead complex infrastructure developments while helping build the systems that make every future project faster, more predictable, and more scalable. What You'll Own Lead the development of AI infrastructure projects from executed agreement through construction readiness. Own integrated development roadmaps, schedules, budgets, milestones, and the pre-construction risk register. Coordinate permitting, entitlement, utility planning, infrastructure planning, and owner obligations. Recommend Go / No-Go decisions as projects advance through key development milestones. Deliver development-ready projects to the Delivery organization with complete documentation and minimized risk. Development Planning & Governance Lead development activities from executed agreement through construction readiness. Develop and manage integrated development roadmaps, schedules, budgets, and key milestones. Own the development budget, schedule, assumptions, and risk register throughout the pre-construction lifecycle. Lead weekly development reviews and executive readiness meetings, and recommend Go / No-Go decisions as projects advance through key milestones. Infrastructure & Utility Coordination Coordinate infrastructure planning for electrical service, substations, fiber, water, sewer, stormwater, and transportation access. Coordinate permitting, utility planning, entitlement activities, infrastructure planning, and owner obligations. Partner with utility providers, municipalities, engineering teams, and consultants to validate executable development plans. Ensure infrastructure assumptions are fully integrated into project budgets and schedules. Construction Readiness Establish development readiness criteria and project handoff standards. Verify permits, utility agreements, infrastructure planning, owner deliverables, and development obligations are complete before turnover. Deliver projects to the Delivery organization with complete documentation, defined scope, and minimized development risk. Identify and resolve development risks before they impact construction. Cross-Functional Collaboration Serve as the primary development interface across Site Selection, Technical Due Diligence, Engineering, Energy, Finance, Legal, and Delivery. Coordinate architects, civil engineers, environmental consultants, surveyors, permitting specialists, and other external partners. Align internal stakeholders and external consultants to prevent scope, schedule, and cost drift throughout development. What Success Looks Like Transform acquisitions into data center-ready development projects. Deliver predictable development schedules, budgets, and readiness milestones. Identify and resolve development risks before they impact construction. Build trusted relationships with utilities, municipalities, consultants, and development partners. Help build the standards and processes the Infrastructure Acquisition Group runs on as it scales. What You'll Bring You're comfortable operating in ambiguity and building processes where none exist. You know how to independently lead complex infrastructure developments while helping define how future projects should be executed. 8+ years of experience in data center development, industrial development, infrastructure development, land development, or mission-critical projects. Experience managing permitting, entitlement, utility coordination, consultant management, and development planning activities. Strong understanding of infrastructure development, owner's budgeting, development scheduling, risk management, and pre-construction planning. Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams across engineering, utilities, design, legal, and construction. Excellent communication and executive presentation skills. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate Development, Urban Planning, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting hyperscale data center or AI infrastructure development. Experience with utility coordination, entitlement strategy, infrastructure planning, and owner's representation. Experience with self-development or joint venture delivery models. Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, or similar professional certification. Why Join Nebius The infrastructure supporting AI is being built now. This is an opportunity to help define how Nebius transforms acquisitions into development-ready AI infrastructure while helping build the function itself—the governance, development standards, readiness framework, and operating model that will support infrastructure investments across the Americas. You'll work on some of the industry's largest and most complex AI infrastructure developments while helping shape the physical foundation of the global AI economy. Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Credit Model Validation Manager
description: We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ London or Remote (UK) | £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits About the team: Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us! Our Credit Model Validation team provides independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence. We help Monzo grow safely and make sure the models we use are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and deliver good outcomes for our customers. You’ll join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across a broad suite of credit models. This is a generalist role rather than one focused on a particular model type. You’ll work across models used for impairment, capital, stress testing, forecasting and credit decisioning, including IFRS 9 PD, LGD, EAD and economic response models; decision science scorecards and origination PD models; and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models. Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is broad expertise in credit risk modelling and model risk management. You’ll have hands-on experience in model validation and/or development within financial services, and be comfortable getting into the data and code to form an independent view across different model types. Your day-to-day Leading hands-on independent validation across Monzo’s credit model portfolio - covering models used for IFRS 9 impairment, capital and stress testing, forecasting, credit decisioning and unit economics - and making sure they are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and performing as expected Reviewing and challenging key model-led credit risk assessments, including impairment adequacy, ICAAP and stress testing, using independent analysis to assess assumptions, limitations and impacts Developing a deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models and how they are used, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers and users Contributing to making model validation more consistent, scalable and technology-enabled - building reusable analytical tools and tests, experimenting with AI-assisted approaches and helping the team embed them safely Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required Performing statistical analyses, model replication and challenger work where appropriate to test assumptions, assess performance and strengthen validation conclusions Improving and helping to embed our Model Risk Framework, including our policies, standards, model inventory, governance and validation approach. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory expectations and that our processes remain proportionate and relevant as modelling techniques evolve Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees Partnering with colleagues in first line of defence credit strategy, modelling and finance teams - and with wider risk teams across Monzo - to support effective model governance and consistent validation standards across the organisation You should apply if you: Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation across a range of model types. You’ll have meaningful experience with IFRS 9 impairment, Internal Ratings Based (IRB) or other capital models, alongside broader exposure to several areas such as stress testing, economic response, forecasting, decision science scorecards or NPV / unit economics modelling Understand model risk management in practice, including independent validation, model governance, ongoing monitoring, model change and issue management, and how regulatory expectations apply across the model lifecycle Are impact-driven and want to improve how validation is done, not only complete individual reviews. You can turn repeatable work into practical methods, tools or guidance that improve quality and consistency across the team. Are curious about AI and automation, and can assess where they add value, the risks they introduce, and the controls and human oversight needed. Experience with AI-assisted analytical or coding tools is useful, but not essential Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep knowledge of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Strong SQL and Python skills are essential. You can produce clear, reusable and tested code, using collaborative practices such as version control, peer review and documentation. Experience with Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus. Can assess models in the context of how they are used - including accounting, capital, credit strategy, risk appetite and customer outcomes - and can distinguish technical model performance from the wider risks of relying on the model Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge Our technology stack We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them): Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure dbt and BigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing Python for data science and machine learning Go to write our application code AWS for most of our backend infrastructure The interview process: Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Meet: An initial call with our recruiter A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling and model risk teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview. A behavioural interview What’s in it for you £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance benefits. This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London). ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences. We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits . We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here . We’ll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out! #LI-TK1 Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

title: AI Benchmark Engineer | Native Language Specialist - French (France) - Remote
description: About The Opportunity We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows. We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches. Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity What You’ll Deliver Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents. Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling. Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary). Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus). Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity. Qualifications Experience: 1+ years of industry experience in software engineering. Background: Proven track record at leading technology companies and/or graduation from top-tier engineering universities. Language: Native or near-native fluency, with a deep understanding of its grammar, register, and phrasing rules. High English proficiency. Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python, standard shell scripting, and data processing. Workflow: Extensive experience with Terminal/CLI-based development workflows and a working familiarity with coding agents. Domain Expertise: Deep technical understanding of multilingual text processing pitfalls, including: Encoding/decoding robustness and Unicode normalization. Locale-dependent conventions (collation, casing, non-Gregorian dates). Text I/O, toolchain interoperability, and safe string operations. (For specific languages) Bidirectional/RTL handling, font fallbacks, and rendering/typography in UI or artifacts. Why Collaborate with Lilt? Your schedule, your rules. As an independent contractor, work when you want, as much or as little as you want. No fixed hours, no check-ins, no micromanaging. Get paid quickly and fairly. We respect your time and your expertise. Competitive rates, prompt payments, no chasing invoices. Work on projects that actually matter . Contribute to cutting-edge AI and language technology that is shaping how humans and machines communicate. Be part of something bigger. Join a global community of linguists, subject matter experts, and language professionals who are advancing human knowledge together. Grow without limits. As a Lilt contractor you get access to diverse, innovative projects that expand your portfolio and sharpen your skills across industries and domains. Have fun doing what you love. Bring your language skills to life on projects that are as interesting as they are impactful.We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows. What to Consider Before Applying Not ideal as a full time job or primary income source. Work availability fluctuates with project demand, making this better suited as a supplemental income stream. As a 1099 contractor, you won't receive benefits such as health insurance, paid time off, or retirement contributions, and hours are not guaranteed. Requires reliable availability and commitment. Once you accept a task, we expect quality work and on-time delivery. Most tasks require a minimum of 2 hours per day or 15-20 hours per week. If your schedule is unpredictable, this may not be the right fit. Geographic restrictions may apply. We cannot engage contractors in regions subject to international embargo or sanctions. As a 1099 contractor, you are solely responsible for your own tax obligations. We recommend consulting a tax professional before engaging. How to join our expert community 1 - Submit your application including an updated copy of your CV in English 2 - Next, complete a GenAI assessment to evaluate your skills 3 - Finalize onboarding and profile set-up in our system, and become eligible for Applied AI projects. AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. LILT's mission is to make the world's information available to everyone, no matter the language they speak. Join our global community who thrive on innovation and excellence. Our collective knowledge, uniqueness, and skills deliver multilingual AI and human-verified services to Enterprises, Governments, and AI Developers around the world. Earn money. Have fun. Advance human knowledge. Work on diverse projects from anywhere, any time you want. Get paid quickly and fairly, and build your professional network in a supportive community—all through a streamlined application process tailored to your expertise. Information collected and processed as part of your application process, including any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to LILT's Privacy Policy at https://lilt.com/legal/privacy . At LILT, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent hiring process. As part of our recruitment efforts, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) and automated tools to assist in the evaluation of applications, including résumé screening, assessment scoring, and interview analysis. title: Senior Fraud Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£108,700 - £140,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our </strong><strong>Financial Crime & Fraud Collective</strong><strong> ⭐</strong></p> <p>We’re all about building trust and keeping our community safe while helping Monzo grow. The Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is at the heart of this work. As a Senior Fraud Risk Manager, you’ll lead the charge in keeping fraudsters at bay so our customers can bank with total confidence!</p> <p>You’ll get to work across current accounts, business banking, international accounts, and more. While you’ll be managing people and programs, you should also be excited to roll up your sleeves and get hands-on.</p> <p>We need a crack team of crime fighters to help us stay one step ahead as we continue to grow. <br><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>Helping to lead our fast-growing global Fraud & Disputes Risk team and work alongside leaders across our cross-functional Fraud Squads. We’re looking for a proactive, collaborative leader who really knows fraud risk management inside and out - spanning several of our authorised fraud, unauthorised fraud, first-party fraud, and disputes specialisms</p> <p>You’ll build great relationships with our Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations teams to design smooth, effective fraud controls, investigation processes, and reporting. You’ll also champion a positive team culture and make sure key fraud initiatives stay on track.</p> <p>Your Core Focus Areas include<strong>:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Fraud Strategy & Operational Execution:</strong> Join squad leadership to turn our big-picture fraud vision into practical roadmaps for our UK and EU Banks. You’ll strike the perfect balance between smart protection controls and a seamless customer experience.</li> <li><strong>Control Framework & Fraud SME:</strong> Be our go-to expert on fraud typologies and prevention tools, overseeing end-to-end design and rollout of strong controls.</li> <li><strong>Threat Intelligence & Performance Analytics:</strong> Embed data and threat monitoring to catch new fraud trends early, turning insights into quick control improvements.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Coordination:</strong> Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Ops to keep initiatives aligned and moving forward.</li> <li><strong>People Leadership & Capability Building</strong>: Coach, mentor, and grow a fantastic fraud risk team while supporting everyone’s personal and professional development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience leading fraud strategy and risk teams, ideally in a fast-moving, regulated environment.</li> <li>You know UK & EU fraud regulations inside out.</li> <li>You’re skilled at building tech-driven fraud strategies that scale across operations.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of delivering end-to-end projects and large-scale change programs.</li> <li>You stay plugged into industry trends and can quickly respond to new fraud risks.</li> <li>You excel at balancing fraud risk with business goals and collaborating to ship new products safely.</li> <li>You’re a supportive coach who loves developing high-performing teams.</li> <li>You’re an empathetic communicator who aligns messaging with our core values.</li> <li>You’re data-driven, comfortable self-serving data, and love using tech to solve problems.</li> <li>You hold a relevant industry qualification (such as ICA, Cifas, ACAMS, or CFE).<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £108,700 - £140,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>30 min call with the recruiter</li> <li>30 min hiring manager call</li> <li>2 hours of technical and leadership principle interviews</li> </ul> <p><br>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-OS1 #LI-REMOTE<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Sr. HR Business Partner

and quality.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Guide</span> a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, the SSCS Add-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll bring</h3> <ul> <li value="1"><span class="textBold">Over 3 years of experience guiding</span> backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments.</li> <li value="2"><span class="textBold">Ability to hire and grow</span> backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles.</li> <li value="3"><span class="textBold">Technical credibility</span> to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure.</li> <li value="4"><span class="textBold">Experience teamwork.</li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The <span class="textBold">SSCS Add-On team</span> is a product engineering team within GitLab’s <span class="textBold">Software Supply Chain Security</span> stage. title: Creative Strategist
description: Leads Power, c’est quoi ? Une agence dont le cœur de métier est la lead gen, avec un pôle e-commerce en plein développement. On gère de gros budgets d’investissement publicitaire, et l’entreprise est portée par des équipes talentueuses. Sur les Social Ads, la créa fait énormément. On cherche la personne qui va alimenter notre pipeline de concepts et qui ne sera jamais à court d’idées. Ton rôle Tu es la machine à idées de l’équipe. Tu trouves les concepts et les angles qui font scaler les comptes, tu les fais produire, puis tu analyses ce que ça donne. Ce poste est stratégique, pas opérationnel : tu imagines et tu pilotes, le studio exécute. Ce que tu fais au quotidien Tu épluches les ads des concurrents et des top spenders pour dénicher les concepts forts : ce qui tourne, depuis combien de temps, pourquoi ça marche Tu suis les tendances organiques (TikTok, Reels, formats, codes, sons) et tu les transformes en pubs qui convertissent Tu es force de proposition en continu : chaque semaine, de nouveaux concepts et de nouveaux angles à tester Tu alimentes le pipeline pour que les comptes ne tombent jamais en fatigue créative Tu analyses les résultats des créas que tu as fait pousser : ce qui marche, ce qui flop, et pourquoi Tu réinjectes ces learnings dans la prochaine vague de concepts Avec qui tu bosses Les Performance Managers : ils pilotent les comptes, te donnent les chiffres et les contraintes, tu leur apportes les idées. Vous construisez ensemble la roadmap de tests et vous vous challengez. Le studio créa (designers, monteurs, motion designers) : tu les briefes et tu les supervises pour que ce que tu as dans la tête sorte exactement comme tu l’avais imaginé. Tu valides avant lancement et tu leur fais un retour sur la performance. Ton profil Tu es hyper curieux : tu regardes de la pub par réflexe, tu scrolles avec un œil de stratège Tu as 1000 idées à la minute et tu sais les transformer en brief clair Tu as de l’expérience sur les créas Social Ads (Meta en priorité, TikTok et Snap en plus) Tu lis les chiffres (CPL, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, CTR) et tu en tires des idées Tu as le sens du copywriting et de la réponse directe Tu sais briefer, challenger et donner du feedback Tu as des exemples concrets de créas que tu as conçues et de leurs résultats Ce poste n’est pas pour toi si Tu veux faire du design ou du montage toi-même Tu attends qu’on te dise quoi chercher Tu n’as aucune réalisation concrète à montrer Ce qu’on te propose 100 % télétravail : tu bosses d’où ça te chante Un vrai impact : tes concepts font scaler des comptes avec de gros budgets Du terrain de jeu : plusieurs verticales, beaucoup de choses à tester Une équipe derrière toi : performance managers, studio, automatisation De l’autonomie pour proposer, tester et structurer le pôle créatif Une évolution liée à tes résultats Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Mind. 2 Teamevents/Jahr + Workation Steuerfreie Sachbezüge und Corporate Benefits Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich von Zuhause aus. Arbeite so, wie es für Dich am besten passt 28 Tage Urlaub: Pro Jahr Unternehmensangehörigkeit gibt es einen Tag mehr Du bekommst für Deinen Arbeitsplatz alles, was Du brauchst: Macbook, Monitor, Firmenhandy etc. Du kannst ihn Dir selbst zusammenstellen, damit du effektiv arbeiten kannst. title: Strategic Partnerships Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3>An overview of this role</h3> <p>As the Director, Strategic Partnerships, you will own GitLab's relationships with its two major cloud infrastructure partners: AWS and Google Cloud. This is a single-threaded owner role, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development & Strategic Partnerships. You will shape partnership strategy from the top down and drive execution from the ground up, this is as much about running the weekly grind of a partnership as it is about setting its direction, turning strategic relationships into durable business outcomes.</p> <p>You will own the commercial relationship end-to-end: managing GitLab's cloud infrastructure spend and consumption commitments, and leading renewal negotiations for enterprise agreements (e.g., EDPs, MACCs, or equivalent) before they come due. You will also own the technical and go-to-market side of each relationship: driving product integrations, shaping joint go-to-market strategy, and connecting GitLab's product roadmap and AI strategy to concrete partner initiatives. This is not a co-sell, channel, or revenue-through-partners role. Success here looks like disciplined commercial ownership, technical integration depth, and renewal outcomes that protect and grow GitLab's position, not partner-sourced pipeline or quota attainment.</p> <p>This role sits close to GitLab's evolving AI strategy and the future of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will develop a clear point of view, represent these partnerships with senior stakeholders, and personally drive the day-to-day work that spans multi-year planning and weekly execution, chasing down blockers, keeping workstreams on track, and doing the detailed follow-through yourself rather than delegating it.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary owner and point of contact for GitLab's cloud infrastructure partnerships with AWS and Google Cloud, personally accountable for the direction, operating rhythm, and outcomes of each.</li> <li>Own the full commercial lifecycle of each relationship: negotiating rates and terms, tracking consumption against committed spend, and leading renewal negotiations well ahead of contract expiration.</li> <li>Manage cloud infrastructure spend as a standing responsibility, partnering with Finance/FinOps on forecasting, true-ups, and cost optimization across both hyperscalers.</li> <li>Drive product integrations with each partner, working directly with engineering and product management counterparts on both sides to identify, scope, and deliver joint technical initiatives.</li> <li>Develop and lead joint go-to-market strategy for each partnership, connecting GitLab's business priorities, product roadmap, and AI strategy to concrete partner initiatives, and then own getting those plans executed.</li> <li>Build strong working relationships across partner organizations, including executives, product management, engineering, sales, and marketing stakeholders.</li> <li>Run a disciplined operating cadence across complex initiatives, with clear priorities, owners, timelines, coordination points, and follow-through you drive yourself.</li> <li>Coordinate cross-functional work inside GitLab to support partnership goals, aligning teams across product, engineering, sales, marketing, finance, and the executive group.</li> <li>Translate partner opportunities and requests into actionable internal plans, including roadmap discussions, integration needs, commercial terms, and executive recommendations.</li> <li>Track and communicate measurable partnership outcomes such as spend efficiency, consumption trends, renewal terms secured, integration progress, and joint go-to-market execution.</li> <li>Represent the partnerships at the executive level by preparing clear recommendations, briefing executives, and helping drive alignment on investments, trade-offs, and next steps.</li> </ul> <h3>What you'll bring</h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience owning strategic partnerships, alliance relationships, or vendor/commercial relationships in enterprise software, cloud, and/or AI, with a track record of being in the details, not just setting direction. This experience should reflect owning one or a small number of relationships in depth, not administering a large multi-partner channel ecosystem.</li> <li>Direct experience managing enterprise cloud commercial agreements (e.g., EDP, MACC, or similar consumption/spend commitments) with at least one major hyperscaler, including experience owning a renewal cycle from expiration planning through negotiation and close.</li> <li>Experience driving product or technical integrations with a cloud partner, and shaping joint go-to-market strategy that connects a product roadmap to partner initiatives.</li> <li>Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate as a single-threaded owner who is accountable for both strategy and execution, and comfortable doing the hands-on work personally rather than handing it off.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex commercial and partnership topics into clear recommendations for executives and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to organize complex workstreams, prioritize effectively, and keep multiple initiatives moving through direct, hands-on management.</li> <li>Genuine technical fluency in software development, platform integrations, and cloud infrastructure, with comfort engaging engineering and product counterparts in substantive conversations, not just positioning technology commercially.</li> <li>Experience working with senior stakeholders on high-visibility initiatives, including preparing executive briefings, framing recommendations, and driving follow-through.</li> <li>Ability to influence without formal authority, build strong working relationships across internal and external teams, and navigate multiple priorities with sound judgment.</li> <li>Familiarity with the DevSecOps ecosystem and a results-oriented approach to measuring partnership impact through spend efficiency and business/product outcomes rather than partner-sourced revenue or quota attainment.</li> <li>Preferred: candidates based in US Eastern or Central time zones, given close cross-functional coordination needs.</li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>The Strategic Partnerships team owns the strategy and relationship management for some of GitLab's most consequential external partners, including the hyperscalers powering GitLab's infrastructure and future AI capabilities. We work across product, engineering, sales, marketing, finance, and the executive group to turn these partnerships into differentiated value for GitLab, manage our infrastructure investment responsibly, and ensure these relationships support our long-term platform strategy.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. title: Business Recruiter, Foundation (G&A)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking for an experienced recruiter to join our Business Recruiting team and support hiring across Notion's Foundation (G&A) organization, including People, Legal, and Finance. You'll be a trusted partner to hiring managers and leaders, owning searches end-to-end, developing creative strategies to find hard-to-reach talent, and helping teams make thoughtful hiring decisions. We're looking for someone who loves the craft of recruiting, thrives on solving complex hiring challenges, and brings a strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and resourcefulness to everything they do. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while helping us raise the bar for how we hire at Notion. This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work. Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time. The Role We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it. This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you. What You'll Work On The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona. The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this. The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one. The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work. Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one. You'll Probably Have Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready. Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy. Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them. Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them. Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server. Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team. An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too. Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same. How We Work We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish. There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point. title: Partner Solutions Architect , AI Builder
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. Supabase is the backend of choice for a growing wave of AI-native builders, and we're deepening structured partnerships with the platforms they build on top of — Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable. These partners' teams are talking to thousands of developers and agents who need exactly what we build—a full backend platform with Postgres at the core—without the vendor lock-in. This is an opportunity to get Supabase in front of the right partner SAs and make us the default recommendation for a modern, AI-ready backend. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Platform Solutions Architect to join our Success Team and help embed Supabase into the Solutions and Engineering communities with AI Builders. You’ll work closely with Partner Solutions Architects and Partner Engineers at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, helping us proactively identify builder problems where Supabase is the right solution and closing the gap between partner intent and real developer outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions of AI-native apps and agents. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll focus on three core pillars: TECHNICAL EVANGELISM & EDUCATION - Build deep relationships with Technical counterparts at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, focusing initially on defined use cases and agent/app-migration motions. - Develop and deliver technical workshops, training materials, and enablement content to give partner SAs the fluency to position Supabase. - Create demos, integration guides, and reference architectures that make Supabase’s fit with Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable immediately legible. - Partner with SAs at these companies on active opportunities to move deals forward and feeding technical pipeline intelligence back to the alliance lead. TECHNICAL SUPPORT & ENABLEMENT - Resolve blockers for partner SAs working on Supabase implementations to maintain their credibility with the builders they support. - Troubleshoot complex integration scenarios and turn solutions into reusable assets. - Maintain a close feedback loop with Supabase product and engineering teams to ensure technical guidance reflects the latest platform capabilities. - Measure success through co-sell opportunities sourced, influenced deals, and SA enablement metrics across the Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable partnerships. CONTENT CREATION & THOUGHT LEADERSHIP - Write technical blog posts and case studies that demonstrate real-world Supabase implementations built on Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable. - Represent Supabase at conferences, meetups, and partner-sponsored events (e.g. Anthropic and OpenAI dev days, Vercel Ship, Lovable community events). - Develop video content and interactive learning experiences to reduce the "time-to-fluency" for partner SAs. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 5+ years of experience in technical roles with deep hands-on experience building on modern AI infrastructure. Previous experience working at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, Lovable (or a similar AI builder platform) or as a partner to one is required. - Understand how partner SAs at AI builder platforms are incentivized, how they make recommendations, and how the partner ecosystem influences developer decisions. - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences, explaining complex concepts with ease. - Have a strong technical foundation in PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern development frameworks like React and Next.js, plus fluency with AI/agent tooling (LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks). - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly to build a playbook from scratch. - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers building the next generation of AI-native products. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
